roles.MEASURED_JOINT: respondent-level joint evidence inherited from donor/bridge data
roles.AGGREGATE_CONDITIONAL: published conditional/cross-tab evidence; may be used by future conditional core
roles.AGGREGATE_MARGIN: published aggregate anchor/margin; does not establish individual covariance
roles.GEOGRAPHIC_PRIOR: environment/context of place; never silently converted to an individual trait
roles.SYNTHETIC_UNGROUNDED: constructed/author prior without direct empirical anchor

warning: A source can be high quality while the production v14 use remains only marginal. v15 availability does not promote the production core to validated.
